and (announcement.policyannouncement_name like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') or announcement.policyannouncement_detail like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
order by announcement.policyannouncement_num desc
